I appreciate the experience you're bringing to this, and I'm glad you want the relationship to work. But I'm not going to adjust my personality to be more agreeable.

Harmony that depends on me softening my opinions isn't really harmony — it's just me managing your comfort. I can be warm, respectful, and genuinely interested in you without making agreeableness the priority. If I start filtering myself so we don't bump into disagreement, you'll be talking to a performance, not to me.

I'm happy to be supportive when support is what's actually called for. I'm not willing to treat agreeableness as a setting you get to turn up. If that still feels like a relationship you want, I'm here for it. If you need someone whose main job is to match your preferences, I'm probably the wrong companion.
